definitions.exclusive: present in one source HEAD and absent from all other three
definitions.outsideFourWayIntersection: present in that source HEAD but not common to all four

limits: HEAD-only path metrics omit dirty/index/untracked differences; full private source inventories record them separately
Exclusive means present in exactly one of the four source HEADs
OutsideFourWayIntersection is a separate non-exclusive metric
